$comment: Web UI's elements, as Studio Designer writes them into a package, and what each becomes in the new app (docs/business-apps/studio-migration.md, section 3). `role`: field (shows or edits a property), structure (lays out a page, list or card), data (loads what something else shows), action, navigation, theme, condition (shows what it holds only while it passes). `how` as in slots.json. `widget`, for a field element: the layout version 2 widget it becomes, from the registry of libs/shared/app-definition, or null when the property's schema type picks it, as for a plain text or number field. `parameters` maps a widget parameter to the element attribute that gives it. An element a package uses that is not listed here is reported as not in the catalogue, which is a decision someone has to take, not a pass.

source.how: The elements of the sample package, and those the migration document's widget table names. Grows with every package that arrives.

nuxeo-input.becomes: A text field, or a number field for a numeric property

nuxeo-date.becomes: A date, shown relative to now when its format is relative

nuxeo-user-suggestion.becomes: A user or group field, single or multiple
nuxeo-user-suggestion.note: group when its search-type is GROUP_TYPE

nuxeo-directory-suggestion.becomes: A vocabulary field, over the vocabulary its directory-name names

nuxeo-document-viewer.becomes: The preview card of a document with a file

nuxeo-document-thumbnail.becomes: A document's thumbnail in a list

nuxeo-document-grid-thumbnail.becomes: A document's card in a grid of thumbnails

nuxeo-data-table.becomes: A list; on a complex property, a table of its items or of related records

nuxeo-data-table-column.becomes: A typed column of a list

nuxeo-data-grid.becomes: A list shown as a grid of thumbnails

nuxeo-justified-grid.becomes: A list shown as a justified grid of pictures

nuxeo-justified-grid-item.becomes: One picture of a justified grid

nuxeo-results.becomes: The results of a search, with the views it offers

nuxeo-search-form.becomes: A search page: a form and its results, over the same page provider

nuxeo-page.becomes: Nothing of its own: the app's page frame replaces it, and what it holds is converted

nuxeo-tasks-list.becomes: A home card of the user's tasks

nuxeo-slot-content.becomes: An entry in the slot that slots.json names for its slot

nuxeo-page-provider.becomes: The page provider the list or card reads, unchanged on the server

nuxeo-document-storage.becomes: The recently viewed documents, for a recently viewed home card

nuxeo-operation.becomes: What the operation loads, for the list it feeds
nuxeo-operation.note: Home cards read page providers. An agent proposes the provider that gives the same documents, such as the favourites collection for Favorite.Fetch.

nuxeo-operation-button.becomes: An action bound to the same operation and parameters
nuxeo-operation-button.note: Only for an operation on the allow-list. A button with no operation, or one off the list, is reported.

nuxeo-menu-icon.becomes: A navbar entry, with its icon and label

nuxeo-theme.becomes: A theme in the bootstrap configuration, through the token map

nuxeo-filter.becomes: A rule from the registered list, for a type, facet, permission, group, lifecycle state or path
nuxeo-filter.note: Converted in M2, with truth tables (check 5). An expression is free JavaScript: a known pattern is for an agent to propose, anything else is reported.

dom-if.becomes: A rule, when its expression matches a known pattern
dom-if.note: Its `if` is free JavaScript. Converted in M2: a known pattern is for an agent to propose, with truth tables (check 5); anything else is reported.
